events.text: The Vindobona began service between Berlin and Vienna via Dresden and Prague.

events.text: The Vindobona was labelled as a EuroCity train connection.

events.text: Vindobona services discontinued.

events.text: A daily direct Intercity-Express high-speed train between Vienna and Berlin via Linz, Passau and Erfurt exists.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Since December 2018 there is a daily direct Intercity-Express high-speed train between Vienna and Berlin

events.text: The name Vindobona is used for Railjet trains between Prague and Graz via Vienna.

events.text: The route was again extended to Berlin.

events.text: The service began using diesel multiple units from Friedrichstraße station to Wien Franz-Josefs-Bahnhof.

events.text: The FDt trains had already begun running between Berlin and Prague.

events.text: The connection was upgraded as Expresszug (Ext 54/55).

events.text: The railcars had first and second class sections.
events.subject: self
events.quote: From December 1957 the railcars had first and second class sections

events.text: Domestic travel within Czechoslovakia was for some years completely forbidden during the period of Normalization.
events.subject: self

events.text: Wien Mitte station became the terminus due to construction at the Franz-Josefs-Bahnhof.

events.text: The DR used a refurbished pre-war DRG Class SVT 137 unit until 1960.

events.quote: The DR used a refurbished pre-war DRG Class SVT 137 unit until 1960

events.quote: ÖBB 5145 ( Blue Lightning ) DMUs from 1962 to 1964

events.text: In 1966 DR introduced its newly engineered VT 18.16 diesel-hydraulic express railcars.

events.quote: In 1966 DR introduced its newly engineered VT 18.16 diesel-hydraulic express railcars

events.subject: self

events.text: The DR operations were taken over by Deutsche Bahn AG.

events.text: With the opening of Berlin Hauptbahnhof, trains passed through Berlin via the new North–South mainline.
